copy.headline: SHIPPING NEEDS MORE THAN AN OPEN STRAIT
copy.deck: Europe promises a Black Sea maritime-security hub but no operational shield yet; the Red Sea escort mission still lacks committed reinforcement. In Hormuz, prices rebound while mine, insurance and owner-risk barriers persist.
copy.mechanism: Maritime security is a separate capacity bottleneck: awareness, escorts, mine clearance and shipowner confidence
copy.chainNote: VESSEL ATTACKS → MARITIME AWARENESS / ESCORT CAPACITY → SAFE PASSAGE
copy.evidenceNote: The €50m hub is an announcement with a 2027 target, not a deployed service; individual attack attribution remains contested.
copy.footer: PLEDGE ≠ PROTECTION · ESCORT REQUEST ≠ DEPLOYMENT · PRICE ≠ SAFE TRANSIT
